Package com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq

package com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq
  • Class
    Description
    AmqpUri
    Pure, dependency-free parser for a RabbitMQ / AMQP 0-9-1 connection URI — no amqp-client required, so it is fully offline-testable.
    AmqpUriException
    Unchecked failure raised when an AMQP connection URI cannot be parsed — a bad scheme, a malformed port, an illegal percent escape or an unexpected extra path segment.
    BindingInfo
    A binding as reported by GET /api/bindings (or /api/bindings/{vhost}).
    DeadLetterArgs
    Pure builder for the x-* arguments passed to a queue.declare so that messages dead-letter to another exchange.
    ExchangeInfo
    An exchange as reported by GET /api/exchanges (or /api/exchanges/{vhost}).
    OverviewInfo
    A trimmed view of the RabbitMQ GET /api/overview response: broker identity and the cluster-wide object/message totals shown on the management home page.
    PublishConfirm
    Outcome of a publisher-confirm round-trip on a confirmSelect channel.
    QueueInfo
    A queue as reported by the RabbitMQ management API (GET /api/queues or /api/queues/{vhost}/{name}).
    RabbitMqManagementClient
    Client for the RabbitMQ HTTP management API (the plugin served on port 15672 at /api).
    RabbitMqManagementClient.Dashboard
    Aggregated snapshot of a single dashboard refresh: the cluster overview plus the queue, exchange and binding lists.
    RabbitMqManagementException
    Unchecked failure from a RabbitMQ management API call (HTTP error, bad JSON, transport error).
    RabbitMqService
    RabbitMQ client wrapper over the official Java amqp-client (AMQP 0.9.1).
    RabbitMqService.Incoming
    A received message, decoupled from amqp-client types for the UI.
    RabbitMqService.MessageListener
    Delivery stream callbacks (invoked off the UI thread, on the amqp-client consumer thread).

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
